subtype_description: Triple-negative (ER-/PR-/HER2-) breast cancer. High proliferation, poor prognosis, BRCA1 mutations common. Responds to chemotherapy.

ER+ with high Ki-67 or HER2+. More aggressive than Luminal A. May benefit from chemotherapy in addition to hormone therapy.
